Remote Work Policy. Employees may work remotely on Tuesday and Thursday. All other weekdays are office days unless a manager approves an exception.
Expense Policy. Employees must submit expense receipts within 10 calendar days of purchase. Manager approval is required for any single expense above 500 dollars.
Security Incident Policy. A suspected security incident must be reported within one hour through the security portal. Employees should not investigate the incident themselves.
Paid Time Off Policy. Every full-time employee receives 15 days of paid time off per calendar year. Planned leave should be requested at least two weeks in advance.
